en: Station Agent
The train back to Nimbasa City leaves shortly.
text: Trenul înapoi spre Orașul Nimbasa pleacă în curând.

en: Will you board?
Then please take a seat and wait for the doors to close.
text: Atunci te rog să iei loc și să aștepți închiderea ușilor.

en: The train pulls away from the turntable and runs west through the woods, back toward the lights of Nimbasa...
text: Trenul se desprinde de placa turnantă și merge spre vest prin pădure, înapoi spre luminile Nimbasei...

en: It's a quiet town. Stay as long as you like, and take a good look at the cars.
text: E un orășel liniștit. Rămâi cât vrei și uită-te bine la vagoane.

en: Station Agent
The cars here are taking a rest. Come at the weekend, when the whole town turns out to see them.
text: Vagoanele se odihnesc aici. Vino în weekend, când tot orașul iese să le vadă.

en: When the yard's full of people, I swear the trains look happier!
text: Când curtea e plină de oameni, pun pariu că trenurile par mai fericite!

en: Collector
I collect anything to do with trains, and my best find is a Klink. All gears and no engine, if you ask me.
A Timburr is what I'm after, though. It'd look splendid with a girder on its shoulder. Will you swap one for my Klink?
Which Pokémon will you swap?
A Timburr! Oh, look at that grip! Take good care of Cogs, now. It likes a bit of oil.
Hmm? That isn't a Timburr. I'm only after a Timburr.
No? Then come back when you've a Timburr in your party. I'll be here at the weekends.
Cogs is doing well? Good! I've polished my Timburr's girder three times this week.
Backer
I tried a swap here once, and it was more fun than I expected. Now I'm after another!
I've a Dwebble that needs a wetter home. Will you swap me a Tympole for it?
Which Pokémon will you swap?
A Tympole! It's sweet! Be gentle with Shelly. She carries her rock very proudly.
Oh, that's not a Tympole. I'm after a Tympole, nothing else.
Never mind. Find me a Tympole, and I'll be waiting.
I hope Shelly's keeping her rock polished. Tympole's lovely, though. It sings to the rain!
Girl
My Pansage hopped onto a train on the way home from the amusement park, and it's been gone ever since.
It must be somewhere about the cars. Would you look for it? It's a shy little thing, and it hides when it hears me.
Any sign of my Pansage? It likes to sit where the sun's warm, and it can't resist a train.
That's my Pansage! Oh, you found it! Come here, you silly thing, you had me so worried!
You must take something for your trouble. Please, it's a Miracle Seed, from my grandfather's garden.
I'll never let go of it on a train again. Thank you!
Pansage hasn't left my side since. It likes the trains, so we go for a ride every weekend, but I hold on tight.
Pansage: Sage! Sage!
The Pansage hops into your arms, looking pleased with itself, and sits quite still. You carry it back to the girl by the fence.
Pansage: Pan! Pan-sage!
